description: Stored agent reports (never overwritten): id, art, ebene, period, datenstand, kurzfassung, text_quelle (agent = written by the Analyse-Agent | zahlen = deterministic server text), model, erstellt_am, delivery log (versendet). With id: the full report incl. inhalt_md and zahlen. Optional: art, limit (default 30, max 200). Admins, planners and agents. Read-only.

art.description: Only reports of this period type

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return
